# Pull Request — Second patch for quick rng fix of logunif function not using the seed

## Summary

Patch include:

* addition of argument to take seed into account of logunif law

---

## Context

Patch concerns:

* sample function in dosimulate.py file

---

## Changes

1/ addition of argument random_state = int(seed) in .rvs()

---

# Reproducibility

Here's a script to reproduce the error with previous versions of ecophylo :
SEED = 12345
N = 10

print("===== TEST uniform =====")

uniform_values = []

for i in range(N):

    x = ecophylo.sample(
        lower=0.0,
        upper=1.0,
        distr="uniform",
        seed=SEED
    )

    uniform_values.append(x)

print(uniform_values)
print("All identical:", len(set(uniform_values)) == 1)


print("\n===== TEST log_unif =====")

log_values = []

for i in range(N):

    x = ecophylo.sample(
        lower=1e-7,
        upper=1e-3,
        distr="log_unif",
        seed=SEED
    )

    log_values.append(x)

print(log_values)
print("All identical:", len(set(log_values)) == 1)


print("\n===== TEST log_unif with numpy reset =====")

log_values_np_reset = []

for i in range(N):

    np.random.seed(SEED)

    x = ecophylo.sample(
        lower=1e-7,
        upper=1e-3,
        distr="log_unif",
        seed=SEED
    )

    log_values_np_reset.append(x)

print(log_values_np_reset)
print("All identical:", len(set(log_values_np_reset)) == 1)



------



# Pull Request — First patch for phylogeny algorithm

## Summary

Patches include:

* removal of UNTB phylogeny transformation
* adapted sumstat.py so it can read sfs of the tree in a genealogy format

---

## Context

Patches concern:

* phylogeny logic in phylogen.py file
* sfs retrieval logic in sumstat.py file
This first patch is only pioneer so one (especially me and my phd) could use the UNTB and have correct sfs.

---

## Changes

1/ Total removal of "if spmodel == 'NTB': block"
2/ Changed the sumstat.py with a (hopefully) temporary argument "spmodel" ; if so, a loop iter through leaves, get their "sp" tag and a Counter counts how many tag is present. Get only the values of the dict and return a list (sfs)

---
